name: Xiaomi Poco X8s
highlights:
Released 2026, October 26
187g, 8.1mm thickness
Android 16, HyperOS 3
256GB/512GB storage, no card slot

BODY.Build: Glass front (Xiaomi Shield Glass), aluminum frame, glass back
BODY.SIM: Nano-SIM + Nano-SIM + eSIM + eSIM (max 2 at a time)
BODY: IP68 dust tight and water resistant (immersible up to 1.5m for 30 min)

DISPLAY.Type: LTPO AMOLED, 68B colors, 120Hz, Dolby Vision, HDR10+, 3500 nits (peak)

PLATFORM.CPU: Octa-core (1x2.8 GHz Cortex-720 & 4x2.4 GHz Cortex-720 & 3x1.8 GHz Cortex-520)

MAIN CAMERA.Triple:
50 MP, f/1.8, (wide), 1/1.55", 1.0µm, PDAF, OIS
50 MP, f/2.2, 57mm (periscope telephoto), PDAF, 2.5x optical zoom
8 MP, f/2.2, 120˚ (ultrawide), 1/4.0", 1.12µm

SOUND.Loudspeaker: Yes, with stereo speakers (with Dolby Atmos)

COMMS.Bluetooth: 5.4, A2DP, LE, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive, LHDC 5, Auracast, ASHA
COMMS.Positioning: GPS (L1+L5), BDS (B1I+B1c+B2a), GALILEO (E1+E5a), QZSS (L1+L5), NavIC (L5), GLONASS

FEATURES.Sensors: Fingerprint (under display, ultrasonic), accelerometer, proximity, gyro, compass

BATTERY.Charging:
100W wired, PD3.0, QC3+, 100W PPS
22.5W reverse wired
